title: The Red Chrysanthemum
alt: The Red Chrysantum flower is pencil drawn and coloured. The background is blue and red. The blue is behind the red flower to pop the red forward. The red is behind the stem of the flower to show the green better.
description: The Red Chrysanthemum is a part of a bouquet of flowers I've gifted my mother. I wanted to practice drawing and using colored pencils to understand how to catch the colors i can spot with my eye.

title: Branches in the Night
alt: Dark blue sketched background with a leave, a branch of flower buds, two of branches with flowers and some abstract fireflies glowing softly.
description: I bought two Creative Kit from the brand Sakura in a retail store, this one is the blue kit. I wanted to experiment with the brush pen. I wasn't sure what to do with it so i experimented using coloured pencils on top of it. It came out simple and cute. It was a bit inspired by the tape i used to hold the pages of the small sketchbook together.

title: Sakura branch
alt: A black and white branch which holds a flower bud and two sakura flowers which are coloured with pink brush pen. Simple flowers are drawn on the background with glitter gel pen.
description: After buying two Creative Kit from the brand Sakura in a retail store, I experimented with the pink one. Drawing a branch with Sakura flowers out of imagination just to experiment with the pens. I immediately used a water brush to create a fade look from the pink brush pen and it turned out sweet.

title: Blueberry Confetti
alt: Loads of blueberries are drawn all over the page with a couple of big ones to give depth.
description: I had bought cheap Acryclic markers and wanted to try something funny and easy to ease in by warming up.

title: Overflowing flowers
alt: Flowers are overflowing a wall with a couple of branches reaching up. In the background there is a sky with a couple of clouds.
description: The inspiration came from Pinterest. Someone had shown the steps how to create this piece and i tried to do it. It turned out to be something simple.

title: Imperfect flower
alt: A darkblue room where a golden hour sun shines inside through the window, giving a single flower in a glass a golden affect from the sun. The glass reflects on the wall along with the outline of the windows which are rectangular.
description: I made this drawing of a photo reference from Pinterest. I wanted to teach myself to be not too perfectionistic as that style isn't achievable with every art medium. So i wanted to learn to enjoy making imperfected art that is beautiful.

title: Leaves in the shadow
alt: A dark brown background with only the shadows of leaves covering the surface.
description: The first time i tried a new set of markers. I really wanted to try and create a shrub of leaves and flowers but i stopped after creating the shadow of it. Something about it just looked good enough to me.
